verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Come and make my heart your home
Come and be everything I am and all I know

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Search me through and through
'til my heart becomes a home for you

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
A home for You Lord
A home for You Lord

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Let everything I do
open the door for You to come through
that my heart may be a place where you want to be
